entities.name: Bohumil Kubišta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bohumil Kubišta was a Czech painter and art critic, one of the founders of Czech modern painting. He, Emil Filla, Antonín Procházka, and five others founded Osma, an Expressionist-oriented group of artists.
